capabilities: Draw a random unchecked task from the checklist at the cursor
Mark the winning task active with a tag, glyph, and selected-at timestamp
Stamp completed-at datetimes when tasks are checked off vault-wide
Restore re-checked tasks to the candidate pool with a fresh start timestamp
Configure the active tag and start/completed glyphs in settings
extras: Community-listing install was pending review at time of writing; completion stamping is always on and applies to every hyphen task in the vault, not only drawn tasks; precise terminology is documented in a separate CONTEXT.md.
motivation: No more staring at a list deciding what to do next; the author also wanted minute-precision completion stamps instead of the Tasks plugin's date-only done dates.
problem: Deciding which task from a list to work on next costs time, and plain task lists don't record when a task was picked or finished.

relations.evidence: This intentionally absorbs and replaces the Tasks plugin's done-date behavior

summary: Random task picker that draws an unchecked item from the Markdown checklist at your cursor and stamps selected-at and completed-at datetimes.
